=== PAGE 55 ===
IX. Rollenspiele / Acting out role-plays
1. Act out the following doctor- / pharmacist-patient conversation.
Schnupfen / Erkältung = runny nose/ cold
Arzt / Pharmazeut:
- Ask the patient their name, birth date and
insurance type.
- How you can help them.
- Duration of the symptoms.
- Additional symptoms
- Where exactly they have the pain
- Intensity of the pain on a pain scale
- How they would describe the pain
- Fever
- You are going to perform a physical examination and prescribe her
tablets for pain and fever
- Pharmacist: You are giving them a medication for their fever and pain
and a cough syrup as well as nasal drops/ spray.
Patientin:
- Irene Fischer, 26. 08. 1995, state insurance
- runny nose
- for three days
- headache, cough
- pain in the forehead
- on a pain scale 7
- throbbing pain
- yes, fever of 38.5 °C (“Ich habe Fieber von achtunddreißig Komma fünf
Grad)
=== PAGE 56 ===
56
2. Act out the following doctor- / pharmacist-patient conversation.
Magen-Darminfekt/ -infektion: Gastrointestinal infection
Arzt/ Pharmazeut:
- Ask the patient their name, birth date and
insurance type.
- If they have ever had a surgery.
- How you can help them.
- Duration of the symptoms.
- How he/she can describe the pain.
- Where exactly it hurts.
- Additional symptoms
- Fever
- You are doing: a physical examination, blood test, stool sample and
ultrasound scan, prescribing/ giving painkiller and antidiarrheal
medication.
- Pharmacist: You are giving them antidiarrheal medication, tablets for the
fever and the pain and suppositories for nausea and dizziness.
Patient:
- Otto Verhoff, 28. 02. 1983, private insurance
- a tonsillectomy and a thyroid surgery
- diarrhea, belly pain
- since yesterday morning
- cramping pain (krampfartig)
- in the lower abdomen, on the left side
- nausea, dizziness
- yes, 37.8°C
